# Test fixtures

Synthetic data written for these tests (CC0-1.0). It is **not** OpenStreetMap data and describes no real place. A 4 x 4 street grid near 41.000 N, 29.000 E with one one-way street (eastbound), one reverse one-way street, a diagonal footway, a private service road, an unconnected street piece, places, a park and a coastline line.
